Tamaam taareefein us Khuda ke liye hain jo aasmaan o zameen ka paida karne waala aur malaaika ko apna paighaambar banaane waala hai, woh malaaika jin ke par do do, teen teen aur chaar chaar hain, aur woh khilqat mein jis qadar chaahta hai izaafa kar deta hai, ke beshak woh har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Allah insaanon ke liye jo rehmat ka darwaaza khol de us ka koi rokne waala nahin hai, aur jis ko rok de us ka koi bhejne waala nahin hai, woh har shai par ghaalib aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Insaano! Apne oopar Allah ki ne'mat ko yaad karo. Kya us ke ilaawa bhi koi khaaliq hai? Wahi tumhein aasmaan aur zameen se rozi deta hai, us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, to tum kis taraf behke chale ja rahe ho
Aur agar yeh log aap ko jhutlaate hain to aap se pehle bahut se rasoolon ko jhutlaaya ja chuka hai, aur tamaam umoor ki baazgasht Khuda hi ki taraf hai
Insaano! Allah ka waada sachcha hai, lihaaza zindagaani-e-duniya tum ko dhoke mein na daal de aur dhoka dene waala tumhein dhoka na de de
Beshak Shaitaan tumhaara dushman hai to use dushman samjho. Woh apne giroh ko sirf is baat ki taraf daawat deta hai ke sab Jahannamiyon mein shaamil ho jaayein
Jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya un ke liye sakht azaab hai, aur jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye un ke liye maghfirat aur bahut bada ajr hai

To kya woh shakhs jis ke bure aamaal ko is tarah aaraasta kar diya gaya ke woh use achchha samajhne laga kisi momin ke baraabar ho sakta hai? Allah jis ko chaahta hai gumraahi mein chhod deta hai aur jis ko chaahta hai hidaayat de deta hai, to aap afsos ki bina par un ke peechhe apni jaan na de dein. Allah un ke kaarobaar se khoob baakhabar hai

Allah hi woh hai jis ne hawaaon ko bheja to woh baadalon ko muntashir karti hain, aur phir hum inhein murda shehar tak le jaate hain aur zameen ke murda ho jaane ke baad use zinda kar dete hain, aur isi tarah murde dobaara uthaaye jaayenge

Jo shakhs bhi izzat ka talabgaar hai woh samajh le ke izzat sab Parwardigar ke liye hai. Paakeeza kalimaat usi ki taraf buland hote hain aur amal-e-saaleh unhein buland karta hai, aur jo log buraaiyon ki tadbeerein karte hain un ke liye shadeed azaab hai, aur un ka makr bahar-haal halaak aur tabaah hone waala hai

Aur Allah hi ne tum ko khaak se paida kiya, phir nutfe se banaaya, phir tumhein joda qaraar diya, aur jo kuch aurat apne shikam mein uthaati hai ya paida karti hai sab us ke ilm se hota hai, aur kisi bhi taweel-ul-umr ko jo umr di jaati hai ya umr mein kami ki jaati hai yeh sab Kitaab-e-Ilaahi mein mazkoor hai, aur Allah ke liye yeh sab kaam bahut aasaan hai

Aur do samandar ek jaise nahin ho sakte, ek ka paani meetha aur khush-gawaar hai aur ek ka khaara aur kadwa hai, aur tum dono se taaza gosht khaate ho aur aise zevaraat baraamad karte ho jo tumhaare pehenne ke kaam aate hain, aur tum kashtiyon ko dekhte ho ke samandar ka seena cheerti chali jaati hain taake tum fazl-e-Khuda talaash kar sako, aur shaayad isi tarah shukr-guzaar bhi ban sako

Woh Khuda raat ko din mein daakhil karta hai aur din ko raat mein. Us ne sooraj aur chaand ko taabe' bana diya hai aur sab apne muqarrara waqt ke mutaabiq sair kar rahe hain. Wahi tumhaara Parwardigar hai, usi ke ikhtiyaar mein saara mulk hai, aur us ke ilaawa tum jinhein aawaaz dete ho woh khurme ki guthli ke chhilke ke baraabar bhi ikhtiyaar ke maalik nahin hain

Tum unhein pukaaroge to tumhaari aawaaz ko na sun sakenge, aur sun lenge to tumhein jawaab na de sakenge, aur qiyaamat ke din to tumhaari shirkat hi ka inkaar kar denge, aur un ki baaton ki ittilaa ek baakhabar hasti ki tarah koi doosra nahin kar sakta
Insaano! Tum sab Allah ki baargaah ke faqeer ho, aur Allah saahib-e-daulat aur qaabil-e-hamd o sana hai
Woh chaahe to tum sab ko utha le jaaye aur tumhaare badle doosri makhlooqaat le aaye
Aur Allah ke liye yeh koi mushkil kaam nahin hai

Aur koi shakhs kisi doosre ke gunaahon ka bojh nahin uthaaega, aur agar kisi ko uthaane ke liye bulaaya bhi jaaega to us mein se kuch bhi na uthaaya ja sakega chaahe woh qaraabat-daar hi kyon na ho. Aap sirf un logon ko dara sakte hain jo az-ghaib Khuda se darne waale hain aur namaaz qaaim karne waale hain, aur jo bhi paakeezgi ikhtiyaar karega woh apne faaide ke liye karega, aur sab ki baazgasht Khuda hi ki taraf hai
Aur andhe aur beena baraabar nahin ho sakte
Aur taareekiyaan aur noor dono baraabar nahin ho sakte
Aur saaya aur dhoop dono baraabar nahin ho sakte
Aur zinda aur murde baraabar nahin ho sakte. Allah jis ko chaahta hai apni baat suna deta hai, aur aap unhein nahin suna sakte jo qabron ke andar rehne waale hain
Aap to sirf daraane waale hain
Hum ne aap ko haq ke saath bashaarat dene waala aur daraane waala bana kar bheja hai, aur koi qaum aisi nahin hai jis mein koi daraane waala na guzra ho
Aur agar yeh log aap ki takzeeb karte hain to un ke pehle waalon ne bhi yahi kiya hai jab un ke paas mursaleen mo'jizaat, saheefe aur raushan kitaab le kar aaye
To hum ne kaafiron ko apni giraft mein le liya, phir hamaara azaab kaisa bhayaanak hua hai

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Khuda ne aasmaan se paani naazil kiya, phir hum ne us se mukhtalif rang ke phal paida kiye, aur pahaadon mein bhi mukhtalif rangon ke safed aur surkh raaste banaaye, aur ba'z bilkul siyaah rang the

Aur insaanon aur chaupaayon aur jaanwaron mein bhi mukhtalif rang ki makhlooqaat paayi jaati hain, lekin Allah se darne waale us ke bandon mein sirf saahibaan-e-ma'rifat hain, beshak Allah saahib-e-izzat aur bahut bakhshne waala hai

Yaqeenan jo log Allah ki kitaab ki tilaawat karte hain aur unhon ne namaaz qaaim ki hai, aur jo kuch hum ne ba-taur-e-rizq diya hai us mein se hamaari raah mein khufiya aur e'laaniya kharch kiya hai, yeh log aisi tijaarat ke umeedwaar hain jis mein kisi tarah ki tabaahi nahin hai
Taake Khuda un ka poora poora ajr de aur apne fazl o karam se izaafa bhi kar de, yaqeenan woh bahut zyaada bakhshne waala aur qadr karne waala hai

Aur jis kitaab ki wahi hum ne aap ki taraf ki hai woh barhaq hai aur apne pehle waali kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne waali hai, aur beshak Allah apne bandon ke haalaat se baakhabar aur khoob dekhne waala hai

Phir hum ne is kitaab ka waaris un afraad ko qaraar diya jinhein apne bandon mein se chun liya, ke un mein se ba'z apne nafs par zulm karne waale hain aur ba'z e'tidaal-pasand hain aur ba'z Khuda ki ijaazat se nekiyon ki taraf sabqat karne waale hain, aur dar-haqeeqat yahi bahut bada fazl o sharaf hai
Yeh log hamesha rehne waali Jannat mein daakhil honge, inhein sone ke kangan aur moti ke zevaraat pehnaaye jaayenge aur un ka libaas Jannat mein resham ka hoga
Aur yeh kahenge ke Khuda ka shukr hai ke us ne hum se ranj o gham ko door kar diya, aur beshak hamaara Parwardigar bahut zyaada bakhshne waala aur qadr-daan hai
Us ne humein apne fazl o karam se aisi rehne ki jagah par waarid kiya hai jahaan na koi thakan humein chhoo sakti hai aur na koi takleef hum tak pahunch sakti hai

Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya un ke liye aatish-e-Jahannam hai, aur na un ki qaza hi aaegi ke mar jaayein aur na azaab hi mein koi takhfeef ki jaaegi, hum isi tarah har kufr karne waale ko saza diya karte hain

Aur yeh wahaan faryaad karenge ke Parwardigar! Humein nikaal le, hum ab nek amal karenge us ke bar-khilaaf jo pehle kiya karte the. To kya hum ne tumhein itni umr nahin di thi jis mein ibrat haasil karne waale ibrat haasil kar sakte the, aur tumhaare paas to daraane waala bhi aaya tha, lihaaza ab azaab ka maza chakho ke zaalimeen ka koi madadgaar nahin hai
Beshak Allah aasmaan o zameen ke ghaib ka jaanne waala hai, aur woh dilon ke chhupe hue asraar ko bhi jaanta hai

Wahi woh Khuda hai jis ne tum ko zameen mein aglon ka jaanasheen banaaya hai. Ab jo kufr karega woh apne kufr ka zimmedaar hoga, aur kufr Parwardigar ki nazar mein kaafiron ke liye siwaaye ghazab-e-Ilaahi aur khasaare ke kisi shai mein izaafa nahin kar sakta hai

Aap keh dijiye ke kya tum logon ne un shuraka ko dekha hai jinhein Khuda ko chhod kar pukaarte ho? Zara mujhe bhi dikhlaao ke unhon ne zameen mein kis cheez ko paida kiya hai, ya un ki koi shirkat aasmaan mein hai, ya hum ne inhein koi kitaab di hai ke us ki taraf se woh kisi daleel ke haamil hain? Yeh kuch nahin hai, asl yeh hai ke zaalimeen aapas mein ek doosre se bhi pur-fareb waada hi karte hain
Beshak Allah zameen o aasmaan ko zaail hone se roke hue hai, aur us ke ilaawa doosra koi sambhaalne waala hota to ab tak dono zaail ho chuke hote, woh bada burdbaar aur bakhshne waala hai

Aur un logon ne baa-qaa'ida qasmein khaayin ke agar hamaare paas koi daraane waala aa gaya to hum tamaam ummaton se zyaada hidaayat-yaafta honge, lekin jab woh daraane waala aa gaya to siwaaye nafrat ke kisi shai mein izaafa nahin hua

Yeh zameen mein istikbaar aur buri chaalon ka nateeja hai, haalaanke buri chaalein chaalbaaz hi ko apne ghere mein le leti hain. To ab yeh guzashta logon ke baare mein Khuda ke tareeqa-e-kaar ke ilaawa kisi cheez ka intezaar nahin kar rahe hain, aur Khuda ka tareeqa-e-kaar bhi na badalne waala hai aur na us mein kisi tarah ka taghayyur ho sakta hai

To kya un logon ne zameen mein sair nahin ki ke dekhein un se pehle waalon ka anjaam kya hua hai, jab ke woh un se zyaada taaqatwar the? Aur Khuda aisa nahin hai ke zameen o aasmaan ki koi shai use aajiz bana sake, woh yaqeenan har shai ka jaanne waala aur us par qudrat rakhne waala hai

Aur agar Allah tamaam insaanon se un ke aamaal ka muwaakhaza kar leta to roo-e-zameen par ek rengne waale ko bhi na chhodta, lekin woh ek makhsoos aur mu'ayyan muddat tak dheel deta hai. Us ke baad jab woh waqt aa jaaega to Parwardigar apne bandon ke baare mein khoob baseerat rakhne waala hai
